parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: I laid me down and slept; <short pause> I awaked; <short pause> for the Lord sustained me. <short pause> Psalm three, verse five.

Father, as I lie down tonight, I trust You to hold me through the hours of sleep. <short pause> You have kept me before, and You will keep me now. <short pause> I rest in Your care, knowing You sustain me through darkness and into morning. <short pause> Amen.
